summary: The @gyomu/ai-compiler package provides compilation and code intelligence pipelines driven by AI models. It handles automated tasks such as JSDoc updates, file and directory summarization, package concept generation, document section building, and content translation.
responsibilities: Define schemas and context models for code transformation and documentation tasks.
Execute AI-driven pipelines for generating JSDoc updates, file summaries, and directory concepts.
Provide strategy and mode resolution for determining the complexity and depth of code transformations.
Implement translation strategies for various documentation formats such as paragraphs, tables, and code blocks.

capabilities.name: JSDoc Updates
capabilities.description: Analyzes source code symbols and generates structural update plans to automatically add or modify JSDoc documentation.

capabilities.name: File and Directory Summarization
capabilities.description: Processes source files and directories to produce cohesive summaries and concept extractions for codebases.

capabilities.name: AI Model Routing
capabilities.description: Defines route identifiers and execution hooks for connecting pipeline tasks to specific AI model providers.

capabilities.name: Document Translation
capabilities.description: Provides strategies for translating structured document content including bullet lists, tables, code blocks, and paragraphs.

designDecisions: Organize functionality around distinct pipeline domains such as JSDoc updates, file summaries, and translations.
Utilize complexity strategies and mode resolvers to dynamically adjust the depth of AI processing based on symbol characteristics.
Leverage immutable schemas and explicit context models to validate and audit automated code modifications.
usageGuidance: Import specific pipeline execution functions from their respective subpath exports rather than internal directories.
Provide well-formed context objects and symbol inputs when invoking pipeline executors to ensure accurate AI model outputs.
